title: From Language to Country to Valence: A Multilingual Audit of Stereotype Bias Across LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.02585v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for education, recruitment, workplace decision support, and other consequential applications, making pre-deployment social-bias detection essential. Yet major benchmarks are English-centred or translated, focus mainly on negative stereotypes, and may miss linguistic and cultural variation. We investigate gender, racial, and religious bias using 12,000 locally written Reddit posts in English, Spanish, French, and German. Only search terms are translated, preserving local context. The dataset is balanced by language and category; English gender is additionally balanced by stereotype valence. Three open-weight and three proprietary API-based models are evaluated with a two-blank design that reduces grammatical-gender cues. Religion has the highest absolute choice imbalance in every model-language condition. Spanish is highest for gender, whereas German is highest for race and religion

translated_title: 从语言到国家再到效价：跨大语言模型的刻板印象偏见多语言审计
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被考虑应用于教育、招聘、工作场所决策支持等具有重大影响的应用场景，这使得部署前的社会偏见检测变得至关重要。然而，现有的主要基准测试以英语为中心或依赖翻译文本，且主要关注负面刻板印象，可能忽略了语言和文化上的差异。我们使用12,000条以英语、西班牙语、法语和德语本地撰写的Reddit帖子来研究性别、种族和宗教偏见。仅搜索词经过翻译，从而保留了本地语境。数据集在语言和类别上保持平衡；英语的性别部分还额外按刻板印象效价进行了平衡。我们采用双空设计（可减少语法性别线索）评估了三个开放权重模型和三个基于API的专有模型。在所有模型-语言组合条件下，宗教类偏见的绝对选择不平衡度最高。性别偏见在西班牙语中最高，而种族和宗教偏见在德语中最高。
tldr: 本研究使用12,000条四种语言本地撰写的Reddit帖子对六个大语言模型进行性别、种族和宗教偏见审计，发现宗教偏见在所有条件下最严重，且偏见程度因语言而异——性别偏见在西班牙语中最强，种族和宗教偏见在德语中最强。
en_tdlr: This study audits six LLMs for gender, racial, and religious bias using 12,000 locally written Reddit posts across four languages, finding religion exhibits the highest choice imbalance in every model-language condition, with Spanish highest for gender bias and German highest for racial and religious bias.
